title: API: a change on a core's own id with isTracked false is ignored and the core keeps its part's state
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-C1 (tracked, Core Charge > 0, so it has a core). Before the run, get the part id of QAPL-C1's core from an API response in the DevTools Network tab (the core has no row on the Inventory list and its Part History page has no on-screen link); if no response exposes it, mark the case Blocked as dev-verified (gap analysis S5-E3 note). No DB access: values the handoff checks in the DB are verified through the API response, the UI and Part History instead.
custom_steps:
1. Open QAPL-C1 from /parts/inventory, change nothing and click Save; in the Network tab copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/change request.
  2. Resend it with "id" set to the core's part id and "isTracked":false.
  3. Reload /parts/inventory and search QAPL-C1.
  4. Open /parts/history/{corePartId} by address and QAPL-C1's Part History (row icon).
  5. Turn QAPL-C1's tracking off in the dialog and Save; then resend the core request from step 2 with "isTracked":true.
  6. Reload /parts/history/{corePartId}.
  7. Cleanup: turn QAPL-C1's tracking on in the dialog and Save.
custom_expected:
1. 201; the row still shows "{n} available".
  2. No flip: the core's own isTracked is ignored (201 or no-op); if the response carries data.is_tracked it reads true.
  3. QAPL-C1 still shows "{n} available"; the parent part is unchanged.
  4. Neither page has a new "Tracking turned off" entry from the core call.
  5. The part reads "Not Tracked" and its core gets "Tracking turned off"; the core call is again ignored (data.is_tracked stays false), so the core keeps its part's untracked state.
  6. The newest core entry is still the "Tracking turned off" from the part's save; no "Tracking turned on" was written by the core call.
  7. QAPL-C1 shows "{n} available" and both histories add "Tracking turned on".
